sessions.title: Plotting ablation results
sessions.prompt: Write a script that plots the ablation results in results/ablation.csv as grouped bar charts.

arguments.content:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

results = pd.read_csv("results/ablation.csv")
results.pivot(index="dataset", columns="variant", values="accuracy").plot.bar()
plt.ylabel("Accuracy")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("figures/ablation.pdf")

sessions.title: Related work on retrieval-augmented agents
sessions.prompt: Summarize the related work section in chapters/related.tex and point out any gaps.
sessions.reasoning: The section covers retrieval augmentation and tool use, but not evaluation.
sessions.reply:
The section groups prior work into retrieval-augmented generation and tool-using agents. Two gaps stand out:

1. No discussion of how agents are evaluated over long horizons.
2. The memory subsection cites only work before 2024.

sessions.title: Tidy tmux key bindings
sessions.prompt: My tmux.conf has a lot of duplicated bindings. Which ones can I remove?
sessions.reply: `bind r source-file` and `bind | split-window -h` are each defined twice. The later definitions win, so you can remove lines 12 and 31.
